name: Engineering Platform

compute.name: Owner Windows workstation (HomePc)
compute.notes: Delivery supervisor and operations dashboard run from a detached checkout under .local/runtime.

compute.name: Second owner PC
compute.notes: Runs its own supervisor and dashboard (ELMA campaigns); owner-confirmed 2026-10-10. No shared portfolio view yet (#79).

databases.name: Control-plane project store
databases.notes: Product control plane persistence (PRODUCT_ROADMAP P1-P5); not deployed.

providers.name: GitHub (gh CLI)
providers.notes: Owner-authenticated CLI used for metadata reads and supervisor PRs/comments.

providers.name: Engineering Platform GitHub App
providers.notes: Required by the control-plane MVP; not registered (docs/GITHUB_APP_SETUP.md).

providers.name: Agent CLIs (Claude, Codex, Cursor)
providers.notes: Supervisor executor chain; Cursor's native sandbox is unavailable on Windows.

secrets.current: Owner's local gh and agent CLI logins on each PC; no secret values in this repository.
secrets.target: Infisical machine identities per environment; GitHub App installation tokens minted on demand, never stored (docs/PRODUCT_ROADMAP.md).
secrets.notes: Do not copy values into the registry.

notes: Primary product: the project control plane (owner decision #77, 2026-10-10), internal first. The delivery supervisor, dashboard and portfolio governance are supporting tooling.
The dashboard and the planned portal are the ui boundary; the platform has no UI review authority yet (#78, #80).
